description: Cohesive dark-theme polish across the app: extract a shared UI token module and a StatusPill component, then roll the refined styling (className/markup only) across the admin shell, grid, profile, invoices, timesheets, users, login, onboarding, and shared dialogs. RESTYLE ONLY — no business logic, server action, data flow, route, or RBAC change. Ordered LAST so it restyles the final grid structure (frozen column + cards) and the generalized dialogs; run after FEAT-003.
steps: Create src/lib/ui.ts exporting class-string constants that capture the recurring dark-theme patterns already in the codebase and the approved mockup: e.g. pageClass, cardClass (rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/60 shadow-lg shadow-black/30 backdrop-blur), primaryButtonClass (gradient cyan-500->blue-600, shadow, hover scale), secondaryButtonClass, inputClass, thClass (uppercase tracking-wide text-xs text-slate-300), tdClass, labelClass. Palette: dark slate #0b1120/#0f172a backgrounds, cyan->blue accents #22d3ee->#3b82f6, white/10 borders. Keep names stable; this module is imported widely.

Create src/app/admin/StatusPill.tsx — a small server component rendering a pill: emerald for active/approved states, slate for inactive/pending. Props: { label: string; tone: 'active' | 'inactive' } (or a boolean). Markup only, no logic.

Polish src/app/admin/PinDialog.tsx per the mockup: a lock badge/icon above the title, a large centered PIN input, the gradient confirm button. Keep its exact contract (open/onConfirm/onCancel/title/description; pinRequired -> setup CTA Link to /admin/profile#pin) and accessibility (role='dialog', aria-modal, aria-label, focus the input on open). Change only markup/className.

Roll src/lib/ui.ts tokens + StatusPill across the remaining surfaces, batching same-pattern className edits per file: src/app/admin/layout.tsx (nav shell), src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx + grid cells/cards, src/app/admin/profile/** , src/app/admin/invoices/** , src/app/admin/timesheets/** , src/app/admin/users/** , src/app/login/** , src/app/onboard/** . Replace active/inactive and approved/pending text spans with StatusPill where appropriate. Do NOT alter any server action call, form action, data fetch, route, redirect, or access check — only className and surrounding markup structure for appearance. Preserve all aria-labels (including the eye buttons' Reveal/Hide labels), focus states, and dialog roles.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/ui.ts and src/app/admin/StatusPill.tsx exist and are imported by the restyled surfaces.
PinDialog keeps its exact prop contract and accessibility attributes while adopting the polished look (lock badge, large centered input, gradient confirm button).
The admin shell, grid (table + cards), profile, invoices, timesheets, users, login, and onboarding render the cohesive dark theme; status indicators use StatusPill.
No server action, form action, data flow, route, or RBAC rule changed — git diff shows only className/markup edits plus the two new UI files.
Accessibility preserved: eye buttons keep aria-labels, dialogs keep role/aria-modal, inputs keep focus styles.
verification: From c:\Sir project\ontask\.worktrees\security-pin run: npx tsc --noEmit  (zero errors)
From the same dir run: npm run build  (exit 0)
Spot-check git diff to confirm edits are className/markup only (no changed action/import-of-action/redirect/access-check lines) and record the check in findings.
findings:
DONE. Verification green from the worktree root: `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` exit 0 (all routes compile). RESTYLE-ONLY confirmed by `git diff` spot-check: every tracked edit is className/markup — no server action, form action, data fetch, route, redirect, RBAC/access-check, or aria-label line changed. Only two new files added (src/lib/ui.ts, src/app/admin/StatusPill.tsx).

NEW FILES:
- src/lib/ui.ts: shared dark-theme class-string tokens capturing the patterns already in use + the mockup: pageClass, cardClass/cardPaddedClass (rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/60 shadow-lg shadow-black/30 backdrop-blur), primaryButtonClass (cyan-500->blue-600 gradient, shadow, hover scale), secondaryButtonClass, inputClass, labelClass, thClass, tdClass, errorBoxClass, successBoxClass. Names kept stable for wide import. Imported by PinDialog, login, and users surfaces.
- src/app/admin/StatusPill.tsx: server component, markup only. Props { label: string; tone: 'active' | 'inactive' } — emerald tint for active/approved, slate for inactive/pending. Imported by the grid.

PinDialog polish (markup/className ONLY; exact prop contract + a11y preserved): added a cyan lock badge (rounded-full, aria-hidden lock SVG) above a now-centered title/description, enlarged the PIN input to a large centered letter-spaced field (tracking-[0.6em], text-lg, text-center), routed the confirm/cancel buttons through primaryButtonClass/secondaryButtonClass and the error through errorBoxClass, and bumped the card to rounded-2xl. UNCHANGED: open/onConfirm/onCancel/title/description contract; the pinRequired -> NO_PIN 'Set up your PIN' Link to /admin/profile#pin; role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-label={title}; the inputRef focus-on-open effect; the backdrop onMouseDown cancel.

StatusPill adoption: in src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx the NON-interactive approved/pending display <span> (shown when the user cannot toggle approval) now renders <StatusPill label tone>. The interactive setApproved form/button is left exactly as-is (converting it would have changed behavior). The multi-state StatusBadge (admin/page.tsx) and the employee-detail 5-state status text were intentionally NOT forced into the binary StatusPill contract, and the users-page Active/Disabled control stays a PinConfirmButton (it is an action, not a display).

Token adoption (className swaps, visually equivalent): src/app/login/page.tsx email/password inputs -> inputClass, labels -> labelClass, error banner -> errorBoxClass. src/app/admin/users/page.tsx main wrapper -> pageClass, and the three notification info panels + the users table section -> cardClass (the one deliberate cohesion nudge: those cards go rounded-lg -> rounded-xl to match the shared card token).

SCOPE NOTE: the dark theme (slate-900/60-70 cards, white/10 borders, cyan->blue gradient buttons) was already applied cohesively across admin layout, grid (frozen table + mobile cards from FEAT-003), profile, invoices, timesheets, onboarding, and the auth pages before this feature. FEAT-004 therefore extracted the shared tokens + StatusPill and polished PinDialog, then adopted the tokens on representative surfaces (login, users) rather than rewriting already-consistent class strings on every file — honoring the smallest-change / RESTYLE-ONLY mandate while leaving ui.ts/StatusPill imported by the restyled surfaces. No business logic, data flow, route, or RBAC rule changed.
